findings.figure: −{pctlo public_open_loop lat_rate_rms lebowski_877m}% to −{pcthi public_open_loop lat_rate_rms lebowski_877m}%
findings.text: Open loop on comma's public segments ({d public_open_loop lat_rate_rms 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m n int} segments from {d public_open_loop lat_rate_rms 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m clusters int} drives): lateral action rate (RMS) of each model scored after lebowski is {pctlo public_open_loop lat_rate_rms lebowski_877m} to {pcthi public_open_loop lat_rate_rms lebowski_877m}% lower than lebowski's. Their lateral gain, the size of the lateral request against the car's motion (1 = same size), is {lo public_open_loop lat_gain others value d2} to {hi public_open_loop lat_gain others value d2}; lebowski's is {v public_open_loop lat_gain lebowski_877m value d2}. Lead of the lateral request over the car's motion, relative to lebowski: Mountain Dew +{d public_open_loop lat_best_lag 8d736683_12864 lebowski_877m delta d2} s ({d public_open_loop lat_best_lag 8d736683_12864 lebowski_877m n int} segments), MD v3 / Flip Flop +{d public_open_loop lat_best_lag 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m delta d2} s ({d public_open_loop lat_best_lag 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m n int} segments); a larger lead means the request best matches the car's motion further ahead. In a separate test aligning each with its own base (residual off) on 16 of comma's cars, their lateral request came 0.26 s (Mountain Dew) and 0.13 s (MD v3 / Flip Flop) earlier; the rest of the difference goes with the smoother request.
findings.line: Lateral action rate of each model after lebowski, against lebowski's, open loop ({d public_open_loop lat_rate_rms 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m n int} segments).

On every other segment, every model is within {maxexcept public_closed_loop xtrack_2s chevy_silverado_s1 d2} m. The means over segments are {lo public_closed_loop xtrack_2s all value d2} to {hi public_closed_loop xtrack_2s all value d2} m and the medians {lo public_closed_loop xtrack_2s all median d2} to {hi public_closed_loop xtrack_2s all median d2} m.
findings.line: Distance from the recorded path at 2 s on chevy_silverado_s1, the {count public_closed_loop} models scored in closed loop; every other segment within {maxexcept public_closed_loop xtrack_2s chevy_silverado_s1 d2} m.
